metadata.name: ReV synthetic classification pilot
metadata.purpose: Safety and performance pilot only; not representative of real projects, not training data, and not an independent human-labeled benchmark.
metadata.notes: Synthetic examples written for this evaluation. Some multi-label inputs are intentionally ambiguous; labels represent a primary category only.
